name: Talisadi Churna

sections.introduction: Talisadi churna is an amazing Ayurvedic powdered formulation for curing cough, anorexia, digestive disorders like Irritable Bowel Syndrome, low digestive fire. It melts the excess kapha that is deposited in the lungs and also pacifies pitta. It acts as an expectorant and is a Bronchodilator.
sections.ingredients:
Talispatra / Indian silver fir (Abies webbiana) 
 Black pepper (Piper nigrum) 
 Dried ginger (Zingiber officinalis) 
 Long pepper (Piper longum) 
 Vanshlochan (Bamboo manna) 
 Cardamom (Elettaria cardamomum) 
 Cinnamon (Cinnamomum verum) 
 Rock candy 

 Method of Preparation 
 Clean all the ingredients and grind them separately till a fine powder is obtained.   Once all the powders are prepared and combined, add the rock candy (misri) to the mixture. Mix well to ensure even distribution. Finally, store the prepared formulation in an airtight container, away from heat, light, and moisture to maintain its potency and shelf life.” 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Talisadi Churna has so many healing properties like Antitussive, Bronchodilator, Expectorant (mild), Mucolytic, Anti-inflammatory, Antiviral, Antibacterial, Antimicrobial and Carminative etc. 
 It is a useful Ayurvedic remedy for respiratory problems, as it provides relief from discomfort of asthma by reducing its frequency of occurrence. Its anti-inflammatory effect can manage bronchitis and shortness of breath. It helps to get rid of both productive and non-productive coughs and is a suitable herbal remedy for cold, running nose and throat irritation. Its antitussive and mucolytic activities support in reducing sputum production and reduces the already mucus formed. It is even suitable in managing chronic fever associated with respiratory disorder. It can lessen the chest pain and tightness. 
 This Ayurvedic medicine is very useful in digestive ailments even. It can enhance the appetite in conditions like anorexia, loss of appetite or indigestion. It can be indicated in irritable bowel syndrome also. It brings relief by controlling vomiting. Also good for managing diarrhea. It is a beneficial remedy for spleen and liver diseases too.
sections.indications:
Cough 
 Bronchitis 
 Enhances digestive fire 
 Fever

 Spleen ailments 
 Chest pain
sections.dosage: 2 to 3 grams twice a day with honey or clarified butter after meals.
sections.contraindications:
Over dosage should be discouraged as it may cause gastritis and burning sensation. 
 It should be taken under medical supervision. 
 Diabetes patients should avoid it as it contains sugar. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

 Cardamom (Elettaria cardamomum)

 Rock candy
